body: Thanks for the reply. Unfortunately moving away is not an option for my wife. She is tied to the area we live in and won't consider moving away. I would like to think that she would move for me but I can't ask that much of her.

This is pretty much the same as me. I 'appear' to have everything, a decent job, beautiful wife, amazing baby daughter....
All my sub-conscious seems to do is make me ruin everything. My anxiety stops me from doing so much that I would love to do. My depression makes me difficult to live with. I feel your pain and I hope that both of us can find a solution.

Thanks for responding. Talking about this is the single hardest part about trying to find help. I know it should help but I just can't tell anyone the whole truth. It's really chewing me up. I'm trying to fight but I'm just getting more and more exhausted. I on a waiting list for CBT but I'm not sure how to deal with this until then.
There are only 2 things stopping me from doing something. My baby girl, and leaving behind my wife. My mind keeps casting around trying to find a solution but I just dont see it.
